messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: (re)arrangement of code
parts:
This email is an extension of conversations I've had with Bob. I'm going through a refactoring of the code base in order to reduce compile times, but I'm blocked on the layout of the code. It's hard to break things out into header / implementation files as-is. Here are some things I want to do (with comments and questions interspersed).



Move stan::agrad to stan::diff
------------------------------------------------------------
This has already been completed. The agrad library has been renamed to diff; namespaces and physical files have been moved appropriately. Could someone review this pull request?
https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/pull/175

I've also done a minor cleanup of the headers, but I really focused on moving namespaces.



stan::math and stan::diff: scalar/array/matrix
------------------------------------------------------------
For src/stan/math, src/stan/diff/rev, and src/stan/diff/fwd, we will have 3 folders: scalar, array, and matrix. There will also be a scalar.hpp, array.hpp, and matrix.hpp. That's what should be included if you want a top-level include. So something like:

#include <stan/math/scalar.hpp>

or for reverse mode scalar:

#include <stan/diff/rev/scalar.hpp>



Error handling??
------------------------------------------------------------
Where should error handling go physically? Should there be a folder inside each of the scalar/array/matrix? Like

src/stan/math/{scalar,array,matrix}/error_handling

Or should we put them in:
src/stan/math/error_handling/{scalar,array,matrix}

Or should we put them in:
src/stan/error_handling/{math,diff/rev,diff/fwd}/{scalar,array,matrix}



Traits??
------------------------------------------------------------
Right now, the traits are in src/stan/meta/traits.hpp. All the traits.

We want to break the dependency on autodiff from meta/traits.hpp. So where do we put those? Should we have:
src/stan/meta/traits.hpp
src/stan/meta/diff/rev/traits.hpp
src/stan/meta/diff/fwd/traits.hpp

or:
src/stan/meta/math/traits.hpp
src/stan/meta/diff/rev/traits.hpp
src/stan/meta/diff/fwd/traits.hpp

or:
src/stan/math/traits.hpp
src/stan/diff/rev/traits.hpp
src/stan/diff/fwd/traits.hpp

or something else?

I can also see us breaking apart the traits to individual files, so traits may become a folder with individual metatemplate programs.





I think I could use help with thinking about error_handling and traits. Any thoughts on anything else is appreciated as well. As soon as we have some of these things spec-ed out, I'll add it to the TO-DO list.
